question: Where can I find restaurant inside 100 kilometers while progressing from Taylor's Aquarium, Dunn, NC toward Wake Forest Art & Frame Gallery, Wake Forest, NC?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-78.589533 35.200429)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-78.509572 35.978307)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE amenity = 'restaurant'
AND ST_DWithin(pois.geometry, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-78.589533 35.200429)',4326)::geography, 100000)
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-78.589533 35.200429)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5);

answers.poi_name: Casa Cubana Restaurant and Rum Bar

[4].display_name: Wake Forest Art & Frame Gallery, Wake Forest, NC
